parameters.text: =Hi {{ $json.message.from.first_name }}! Kisi ne aapke bacche ke baare mein darane wali call ki ho, toh neeche ka button dabao. (ID: {{ $json.message.chat.id }})
=Valid8: {{ $('Find Parent').item.json.name }} ko aapke baare mein ek darane wali call aayi hai. Kya aap safe ho? Neeche button dabao.
=🆘 VALID8 ALERT: {{ $('Find Responder').item.json.name }} ne HELP dabaya hai! Turant 112 pe call karo. {{ $('Find Responder').item.json.name }} ko apne phone se seedha call karo.
Shukriya! Confirm karne ke liye apna 4-digit Safe PIN type karke bhejo.

=✅ VALID8: {{ $('PIN Sender').first().json.name }} ne apne Safe PIN ke saath confirm kiya hai ki wo SAFE hai. PAISE MAT BHEJO. Ye call scam hone ka HIGH RISK hai. Caller ka number note kar lo, report karne mein kaam aayega.

=⚠️ VALID8 WARNING: {{ $('PIN Sender').first().json.name }} ke phone se GALAT PIN aaya hai (attempt {{ Number($('Get Case').first().json.attempts || 0) + 1 }}/3). {{ Number($('Get Case').first().json.attempts || 0) + 1 >= 3 ? 'PIN 3 baar galat hua, ab ye check LOCK hai.' : 'Ho sakta hai phone kisi aur ke paas ho.' }} PAISE MAT BHEJO. Turant 112 pe call karo.

=Valid8: {{ $('Find Parent').first().json.name }} ko {{ $('Find Child').first().json.name }} ke baare mein ek darane wali call aayi hai, aur {{ $('Find Child').first().json.name }} se abhi sampark nahi ho pa raha. Agar aap {{ $('Find Child').first().json.name }} ke saath ho ya use abhi call kar sakte ho, toh please check karke {{ $('Find Parent').first().json.name }} ko batao.

={{ $('Telegram Trigger').first().json.callback_query.data.startsWith('csafe') ? Ye ek trusted contact ka jawab hai, bacche ka apna PIN nahi. Phir bhi paise mat bhejo aur bacche ko seedha call karke confirm karo.' : '⚠️ VALID8: ' + $('Find Responder').first().json.name + ' bhi ' + $('Telegram Trigger').first().json.callback_query.data.split(':')[1] + ' se sampark nahi kar paaya. PAISE MAT BHEJO. Turant 112 pe call karo.' }}

=⚠️ VALID8: UNCONFIRMED. {{ $('Find Child').first().json.name }} aur trusted contact ko poocha gaya, par 60 second mein kisi ka jawab nahi aaya. Ye na scam sabit hota hai, na sach. Isliye caller ke kehne par abhi paise mat bhejo. Turant 112 pe call karke police ko batao. {{ $('Find Child').first().json.name }} ko seedha call karne ki koshish bhi karo.
=⏳ VALID8: {{ $('Find Child').first().json.name }} ne 30 second mein jawab nahi diya. Ab trusted contacts se pooch rahe hain. Jawab 30 second mein aayega. Tab tak caller ke kehne par paise mat bhejo.
